create_scalar_affine_bijector: create a ScalarAffine bijector with shift and scale parameters for elementwise affine transformation
forward_transform_with_jacobian: compute the forward transformation y=scale*x+shift and its log determinant Jacobian
inverse_transform_with_jacobian: compute the inverse transformation x=(y-shift)/scale and its log determinant Jacobian
create_bijector_with_log_scale: create a ScalarAffine bijector using unconstrained log_scale instead of raw scale parameter
compare_bijectors_with_same_as: compare two ScalarAffine bijectors to check if they have identical shift and scale parameters
